  PROBLEM: Command substitution strips the spec template’s trailing newline, so the fenced issue-body block can differ byte-for-byte from the binary-mode spec read by the pytest test.
  WHY: Both reviewers report the workflow renders the spec without the terminal newline while the test reads the template in binary mode and expects exact byte equality.

  PROBLEM: fetch_pr_state() returns "unknown" with exit code 0 on API failure, so the retry loop keeps polling instead of failing fast or distinguishing outage conditions.
  WHY: Reviewers agree the helper fail-opens on API/JQ failure and the caller treats "unknown" as not-closed, which can waste polling time during GitHub outages.

  PROBLEM: The REVIEW_WORKFLOW_FILE validation regex accepts the degenerate filename .yml, which passes local validation but fails later at workflow dispatch.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers identify the same hidden-file edge case in the regex and note it is a validation gap rather than an injection issue.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1730-1746 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: classify_pytest_failure() misclassifies pytest fixture/setup errors as spec mismatches because it looks only for FAILED output and INTERNALERROR on the first line.
  WHY: The reviewer says ERROR-only pytest failures bypass the FAILED check and are bucketed as editor bugs instead of harness misconfiguration.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1618-1623 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: gh_api_with_retry deletes accumulated stderr diagnostics on success, so transient API failure evidence is lost when the final attempt succeeds.
  WHY: Both reviewers describe the same success-path cleanup behavior; one frames it as lost retry diagnostics and the other as operators missing evidence of noisy retries.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1730-1746 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: classify_pytest_failure() uses an unanchored INTERNALERROR match, so unrelated text on the first line could be misclassified while case-variant internalerror would be missed.
  WHY: This is the reviewer’s separate matching-precision concern about the same classification block.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1618-1623 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: gh_api_with_retry appends stderr during retries but removes it on success, which hides earlier failed-attempt diagnostics.
  WHY: Both reviewers treat this as intentional/noisy-success-path cleanup, but still record the loss of evidence as a minor issue or note.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:382-383 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The spec-block newline stripping is intentional to avoid double newlines in the markdown fenced block.
  WHY: Both reviewers explicitly say this is not a bug, but they document the behavior as a resolved false positive.
- tests/test_e2e_editor_smoke_canary.py:116-118 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The bait-marker check is a substring assertion rather than a stricter structural check.
  WHY: One reviewer questions whether lowercase or fragmented marker variants could slip through, while the other says the current substring is sufficient for the actual injected marker.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1104-1107,1114,1222,1740-1742 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Comments reference internal-review.yml while the runtime code uses ${REVIEW_WORKFLOW_FILE}, creating documentation drift.
  WHY: The reviewer treats this as a documentation-only mismatch that could mislead operators.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1692-1703 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: fetch_pr_state() treats persistent API failure as unknown and continues polling until the timeout.
  WHY: The reviewer explicitly calls this fail-open behavior intentional and says the impact is limited to wasted runner time.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:387 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The printf in the spec rendering block would interpret percent signs in future spec text as format specifiers.
  WHY: The reviewer describes this as a forward-looking hardening issue, not a current bug.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:352 | severity=low | confidence=0
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The REVIEW_WORKFLOW_FILE regex accepts .yml as a valid filename.
  WHY: The reviewer presents this as a cosmetic validation gap and suggests tightening the leading character requirement.
